states.changed: A reader meets the world's counted AI chip stock by owner for every quarter since 2022 with its uncertainty band, can show the unfinished quarter behind the published 75.8 %, and reads seven sourced edges of what the record cannot see.

A reader meets a second answer to 'by whom': every published compute agreement between frontier developers and their providers, as lines from owner to user that can be weighed in money, power or chips, each with its passage, beside the ownership shares.

A reader meets a fifth section, who can end or stop each of the 19 agreements, read from the filed contracts (13 say nothing in public; a state can only order a suspension), the money divided by its own term instead of one summed figure, and the cluster shares corrected to what stood at the end of 2025.
